name: type effectiveness changes the winner
input: water attack is strong against fire
test:
team_a = [{'name': 'ember', 'hp': 10, 'type': 'fire', 'attacks': [{'name': 'spark', 'damage': 4, 'type': 'fire'}]}]
team_b = [{'name': 'splash', 'hp': 12, 'type': 'water', 'attacks': [{'name': 'wave', 'damage': 6, 'type': 'water'}]}]
rules = {('water', 'fire'): 2.0, ('fire', 'water'): 0.5}
winner, log = simulate_battle(team_a, team_b, rules)
assert winner == 1
assert log[1] == ('splash', 'wave', 'ember', 12, 0)

name: chooses the best attack and breaks ties by order
test:
team_a = [{'name': 'alpha', 'hp': 20, 'type': 'normal', 'attacks': [{'name': 'first', 'damage': 5, 'type': 'normal'}, {'name': 'second', 'damage': 5, 'type': 'normal'}, {'name': 'boosted', 'damage': 4, 'type': 'ice'}]}]
team_b = [{'name': 'beta', 'hp': 6, 'type': 'grass', 'attacks': [{'name': 'tap', 'damage': 1, 'type': 'normal'}]}]
rules = {('ice', 'grass'): 2.0}
winner, log = simulate_battle(team_a, team_b, rules)
assert log[0][:4] == ('alpha', 'boosted', 'beta', 8)
assert winner == 0

name: skips defeated monsters in team order
test:
team_a = [{'name': 'hero', 'hp': 30, 'type': 'normal', 'attacks': [{'name': 'hit', 'damage': 5, 'type': 'normal'}]}]
team_b = [
    {'name': 'front', 'hp': 5, 'type': 'normal', 'attacks': [{'name': 'tap', 'damage': 1, 'type': 'normal'}]},
    {'name': 'back', 'hp': 5, 'type': 'normal', 'attacks': [{'name': 'tap', 'damage': 1, 'type': 'normal'}]},
]
winner, log = simulate_battle(team_a, team_b, {})
defenders = [entry[2] for entry in log if entry[0] == 'hero']
assert defenders[:2] == ['front', 'back']
assert winner == 0

name: does not mutate caller inputs
test:
team_a = [{'name': 'a', 'hp': 10, 'type': 'x', 'attacks': [{'name': 'hit', 'damage': 10, 'type': 'x'}]}]
team_b = [{'name': 'b', 'hp': 3, 'type': 'x', 'attacks': [{'name': 'hit', 'damage': 1, 'type': 'x'}]}]
original_b_hp = team_b[0]['hp']
simulate_battle(team_a, team_b, {})
assert team_b[0]['hp'] == original_b_hp
